translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content: Nkunga bana ba babakala ba Kole kuidi pfumu minyimbidi.

content.text: Luwa diambu diadi beno batu boso :
Ludimba beno batu boso lunzinganga va nza yayi,
batu baphamba ayi batu banneni,
zimvuama ayi minsukami.
Munuꞌama wela tuba mambu ma nduenga,
mamo mantotukila mu ntimꞌama mela vana tsudukulu.
Ndiela balula dikutu diama mu diambu di wa zingana,
mu ngitala, ndiela sudikisila nongoꞌama.
Bila mbi mfueti monina tsisi
bilumbu bi mbimbi bu bizidi,
mu thangu mambimbi ma bobo beti vuna batu manzungididi e ?
Bantulanga diana diawu mu bima biawu
ayi beti kukiniemisa mu kimvuama kiawu kiwombo.
Mutu kalendi baka bu kuidila ko, luzingu lu mutu wunkaka,
voti futa thalu yi khudulu andi kuidi Nzambi.
Thalu yi khudulu yi luzingu yibeki luvalu lunneni,
kuisi ko kadi mfutu wulenda dedakana,
mu diambu kazinga mu zithangu zioso
ayi kabika bola.
Bila babo beti mona ti bankua nduenga balembo fua ;
bivungisi ayi bivulu balembo fua mamvawu,
ayi balembo biki bima biawu kuidi batu bankaka.
Biziami biawu biela banga zinzo ziawu mu zithangu zioso ;
bibuangu biawu biobi beta vuanda mu tsungi ka tsungi.
Beti vana mazina mawu mu mintoto miawu bu bafuidi.
Vayi mutu, ka diambu ko beki kimvuama kazinganga buwombo ko.
Dedikini banga bibulu bieti fua.
Mawu mama mambu meti buila batu bobo beti tula diana mu bawu veka
ayi bobo beti kuba landakana,
bobo beti kikina mambu beti tuba.
Banga nkangu wu mamemi, bakubuku mu diambu di tsi bafua ;
lufua luela kuba dia.
Mutu widi ntima wululama wela kuba yadila va nsuka
buphila buawu buela bola ku tsi bafua,
thama ayi zinzo ziawu zi kipfumu.
Vayi Nzambi wela kula luzingu luama mu lulendo lu tsi bafua,
bukiedika wela kuthambula mu diambu diandi veka.
Kadi mona tsisi mutu bu kalembo baki kimvuama
kiezila ki nzo andi bu kilembo buelama.
Bila kalendi nata kadi kima ko mu thangu kela fua.
Kiezila kiandi kilendi kuluka yandi ko.
Bu kabedi moyo wukimona mutu wu lusakumunu
ayi batu beti kuzitisa bu weti mona lusakumunu
bu kabedi monanga mamboti.
Wela kuenda bata tsungi yi madise mandi ;
bobo balendi buela mona kiezila ko ki luzingu.
Mutu widi kimvuama ayi kambulu diela
widi banga bulu kieti fua.
